H-LOG 2026.08.11 [EN]

📈 [2026-08-11 18:07]

H-LOG: Professionals Report

the cash session (Spot)

  • Situation on the cash market (NDX, QQQ): Indices are recording slight declines (NDX: -0.19%, QQQ: -0.22%), which correlates with negative cumulative energy flow (CVD). A negative flow of -48.1 M shares was recorded on the NDX, which, given the current dynamics, indicates selling pressure, although this scale does not show an anomaly of institutional absorption.
  • the futures session (NQ): NQ futures contracts show a correlation with the spot (price: 29673.75, -0.21%) with a negative CVD energy flow (-14,49 K), confirming supply dominance in the current interval.
  • Sentiment and broad market: The aggregate flow direction indicator is -8, signaling a slight prevalence of capital distribution. Nevertheless, the TICKQ (Background Radiation) indicator (126.00) is above its SMA200 (108.53), suggesting a relatively strong internal market structure despite price declines.
  • QQQ option analysis: The options market shows increased activity (volume: 2,920,428) with a Put/Call Ratio at 1.09, suggesting a slight shift towards hedging or expectations of declines. With implied volatility (IV) at 20.06%, the market prices the expected range of QQQ movement within the 716.29 – 727.73 interval.
